_note: Canned model responses for dry-run mode (offline demo). TEST DATA.

K1.criteria: Placements or payouts stop if it fails: CRM, student data, billing/payout.

K2.criteria: Daily work slows if it fails: file storage, office suite, Excel lists, intranet.

K3.criteria: Duplicates a UCM tool, or unused for more than unused_days.

track_logic: Structured data (CRM, student lists, Excel lists) -> semantic_layer mapping onto UCM objects.
Documents (SharePoint, drives, wiki) -> sweep: export, tag, move into Google Workspace / Confluence.
Duplicate of a UCM tool -> sunset: export content, switch off by Day 30.
Before any switch-off: extract knowledge (decisions, how-tos, owners) into Confluence / Drive.
Rules disagree or nothing matches -> execute model; if still unclear -> needs_human.

Guest channels with clients or partners (who, why)

Page owners and last editors (knowledge holders)
